title: •Chewie
caption: •Chewie (V)
game_text: {pilot:3}, 4: _Falcon_. While piloting _Falcon_, it is maneuver +2, Chewie draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise, and your battle destiny draws (and total battle destiny) at same system may not be modified, canceled, or reset by opponent.
lore: Loyal Wookiee companion of Captain Han Solo. Co-pilot of the _Millennium Falcon_. Leia referred to him as a “walking carpet.”
expansion: The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game

notes: Unique. Stats POWER 6 / ABILITY 2, third box blank; deploy 3 / forfeit 6. Icon column top to bottom: pilot, warrior (the printed card has only a pilot icon). Rebel (Rebel disc on the printed card). Inline yellow pilot icon + '3, 4: Falcon' → {pilot:3}, 4: _Falcon_ (stub expands 'Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. 4: Falcon'); Falcon italic both times. The stub's 'Decipher base: [[Chewie]]' is a red link — no 'Chewie' page exists; the printed base is the ESB Introductory Two-Player Game card ('Chewie (The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game)'). Lore corrected from the scan and the 745 px V0 remake: _Millennium Falcon_ italic (wiki plain 'Millennium Falcon') and curly double quotes “walking carpet.” with the period inside (wiki 'walking carpet.' in straight single quotes). Base scan only at 350 px (ESB2P-L-chewie.gif); copyright 1996 read on the V0 remake's line (also visible as 1996 on the 350 scan). The printed card shows a grey expansion ring icon beside the lore box (ESB 2-player game). Modern: V0-L-chewie.gif (745 px, PC Virtual Set 0 remake: text '{pilot:3}. While piloting Falcon…' without the ', 4: Falcon' clause — art only); VB2-L-chewie(-pre).gif (350) also exists, not downloaded.
